title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned Accession Register — each scraped ad is a numbered holding in a working library register. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll. Seven-segment, depot blind, Miura sheet, cyclorama, and elbow panel wait in the demoted row as declined donations.

options.label: Accession Register
options.lineage: library accession books, date stamps, and manila item cards on a daylight desk
options.thesis: Every competitor ad is a numbered accession in a working register, not a card in a dashboard.
options.viewport: A cool ledger sheet: URL lots and Run as the accession header; the holdings table owns the page; a manila card drawer waits closed on the right.
options.risk: Library metaphor can read cute if the stamp is decorative instead of the real job state.

raised.raise: Absence is drawn: empty classify cells are ghost stamps, not blank voids; a missing TypeSafe key blinks like an unset clock.
A failed URL lot stops mid-step — two half-states on one seam — and the active row inverts like the lead destination panel.
Run deploys the holdings as one stepped field; columns never reshuffle mid-scan.
Named phases — empty, accessioning, holdings, classifying, classified — not a spinner-only story.
Accession ids, URL index, and ad ids sit as numeric code clusters, not pretty titles.

options.label: Insertion-Order Desk
options.lineage: media traffic logs, insertion orders, and line-item grids on a buyer’s desk
options.thesis: The run is a traffic log: each pasted URL is a line item, each ad a booked spot.
options.viewport: A dense traffic sheet: paste URLs as new lines, Run as traffic, the table as the as-booked log.
options.risk: This is the familiar media-ops landing — most runs in this category would ship it.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.lineage: 1971 pocket airline timetable on a light table, one type size, tinted glass slides
options.thesis: Holdings scan like a raked timetable: one type size, rank by weight, case, and rule.
options.viewport: A raked rack of slides: URL lots as heading strips, ads as departure columns, one size throughout.
options.case: Holds product clarity — a one-size dense table is the job — but strategists do not identify with airline glass.
options.risk: The rake and gold bed can costume the register if they outrank the holdings.

options.label: Seven-Segment Clock
options.lineage: bedside clocks, gas-station totems, scoreboards sharing one eight-cell mask
options.thesis: Progress and ids as lit segments; empty cells stay drawn as ghosts.
options.viewport: A mask of cells: URL i/5 as digits, holdings as a rigid slot grid.
options.case: Loses both axes: strategists do not live in LED clocks, and body copy cannot be segments.
options.kept: Absence is drawn; the missing-key state blinks like 12:00.
options.risk: Novelty digits would bury the ad body.

options.label: Depot Destination Blind
options.lineage: bias-cut duck-cloth destination blinds stepping under one depot window
options.thesis: URL lots step under one window; a fault stops mid-course across a seam.
options.viewport: One fixed window: lots snap by the course; a failed URL shows two half-legends.
options.case: Transit ops, not creative strategy; cloth courses fight a readable ad table.
options.kept: Failed lots stop mid-step; the active row inverts.
options.risk: The window would hide the holdings table.

options.label: Miura Orbit Sheet
options.lineage: a gold packet that deploys into a rigid tessellated sail
options.thesis: Run is one pull that deploys the crease field of holdings.
options.viewport: A compact packet at rest; Run unfolds the table as linked creases.
options.case: Origami identification is foreign; a fold fight with scan-a-table loses.
options.kept: Run deploys one stepped field; columns never reshuffle.
options.risk: Deployment theater delays the first row.

options.label: Cyclorama Dawn
options.lineage: a seamless cyc passing from night through cobalt and rose into day
options.thesis: Collection phases are named light cues, not a spinner.
options.viewport: Horizon bands: empty night, first ads as first light, classified as day.
options.case: Theater atmosphere is not the strategist’s desk; color-phase fails Operate scan.
options.kept: Named phases instead of spinner-only progress.

options.label: Elbow Panel Console
options.lineage: pill-cornered starship wall panels, pastel blocks on pure black
options.thesis: Lots and ads as numeric code clusters inside color banks.
options.viewport: An elbow frame: paste as one bank, holdings as another, ids as codes.
options.case: Sci-fi console has no audience home; pastel banks hide ad copy.
options.kept: Ids as numeric code clusters, not pretty titles.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean analyst dashboard: left inputs, center table, right detail, executed at full craft.
canonCard.viewport: App shell with sidebar, data table, and slide-over — the arrangement this category always ships.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other ad-intel tool by design.
